BOQ
Bill of quantities: the client's list of work lines, each with a description, unit and quantity.
Selected BOQ
A BOQ marked as the one the project runs on. Only Selected BOQs show in Estimates.
Line item
One priced work line of a BOQ sheet (not a heading, note or subtotal). Estimates hang on line items.
Material estimate
The materials one BOQ line item needs: items from the Items list, or custom items, each with a quantity.
Estimate Items
The new column in BOQ View, and the third sub-tab that adds materials up across lines and BOQs.
Commit / re-commit
Saving a reviewed BOQ sheet as a new version. The old version's lines are frozen, never deleted.
Copy after commit
A background job queued after each commit. It copies every estimate onto the same unchanged line of the new version.
Re-attach
The manual button for estimates still on an older version: it copies them to the new version now.
Settled
An older estimate that was copied forward or resolved. It stays in its version's history and is not listed again.
Background job / worker
Work the server does after the request returns. A worker process runs queued jobs; this walk started one for its env.
NOS
Numbers: a unit counted in whole pieces. The form refuses decimals on it.
Completed project
A finished project. Estimates there are read-only.
Before / After
Before is the code the PR starts from (develop at 42313959a). After is the PR's own code (3ec7eb84f).
Role check
A test that one role sees, or does not see, what the PR says it should.
Must / Should / Nit / Note
How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
